verdicts.reason: A scales the bottle up so much that it takes over the frame and competes with the '20% off' headline. Its cap sits close to the top edge, the left text column is pushed tight against the left edge (about 12px margin), and the body copy wraps awkwardly to three lines with 'sparkling.' left alone on the last line. B keeps the original proportions and hierarchy: it has a consistent left margin, the copy breaks into two clean lines, and the bottle and circle are balanced against the text. Its flaws are minor: the bottle is fairly small and the space at the bottom is a little uneven.
